rows.ARS:
Light pink Floribunda.
Registration name: Giliane ® (floribunda, Sauvageot 2004)
rows.Bloom: Carmine-pink. Mild fragrance. up to 70 petals. Very full (41+ petals), cluster-flowered, cupped, ruffled bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Habit:
Bushy. Medium, semi-glossy, dark green foliage.

Height: 2' to 39" (60 to 100cm). Width: up to 20" (up to 50cm).
rows.Parentage: If you know the parentage of this rose, or other details, please contact us.
